description: Error-normalization fixtures. All domain failures arrive as JSON-RPC successes with isError=true; only transport faults are JSON-RPC errors. The adapter maps each to a typed, credential-free error class.

cases.name: domain-iserror
cases.expect: typed validation error; never retried as transient

cases.name: auth-401
cases.expect: hard setup error (authorization failures are never retried); constant-time compare path on 3333 /mcp

cases.name: oversized-response

http.note: response body exceeds the adapter's configured response bound

cases.expect: typed safe failure; payload is never parsed into memory beyond the bound
cases.citation: PRD T04: invalid/oversized backend responses produce typed safe failures

cases.name: redirect-credential-leak
cases.expect: reject before following; credentials must never be forwarded to a redirected host

cases.name: timeout-and-cancel

wire.note: client aborts the request context; mcp-go propagates cancellation into backend REST calls

cases.expect: pending request terminates within the configured bound; typed timeout error
